args.body: Use the queued executed-controls/result.json and runner-and-fixtures.json if committed and no equivalent execution already exists. Read the verbatim field comment in context before endorsing the rule. If the automated extraction is inconclusive, inspect the committed proto directly before spending a FETCH. On passing controls, use the actual output to finish the short EN/FR operator example and make the runner and fixtures directly usable. State that family labels are supplied and that the check neither infers families nor validates Merchant Center acceptance. Read back the deliverables before closing under a valid lease with a lesson. Keep all files outside the public site.

description: Treasury shows no verified funding or revenue. Feedback is available, but five unclassified sources and ten skipped events leave demand unknown. The committed Merchant Products v1 source gives the catalogue team a way to test a specific merchant QA rule after the earlier overview yielded no field-level evidence. The queued run checks the exact source first, then exercises passing and failing fictional CSVs if the rule is supported. Results remain pending, and any public placement requires independent review of the exact digest.
